title: 追憶の先のプリンシプル

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I get an idea to address Biwa Hayahide's anxiety by setting up a scrimmage between her and Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide loses, but her loss facilitates a major breakthrough. She realizes she started creating her equation because of a desire not to lose to her sister, Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Success, though, isn't just about not losing. It's about winning. So we resolve to create a real winning equation from scratch… hopefully in time for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin give their full support.
